verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a first-party subscription management product under Airwallex Billing. It supports multi-item subscriptions (e.g., a license plus support), multi-frequency schedules (annual fee plus monthly support), recurring invoices, and hosted or embedded billing checkout, so the recurring-billing core is covered. The pack says nothing about trials, plan upgrades or downgrades, or proration. missing for 10: documented free trials, mid-cycle upgrade/downgrade handling, proration logic, explicit plan/price API objects, independent or hands-on corroboration.
